players.product: Nebula autonomous lab, RAC robotics, and Ginkgo Datapoints

quarterly_data.signal: Ginkgo's Q2 2026 results release: Ginkgo has begun work on a $47 million, 97-instrument autonomous lab for the Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory (EMSL) at Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, and Caltech, Northwestern and the University of Maryland have commissioned autonomous labs to be built by Ginkgo under the NSF's ~$400 million investment in a national network of AI-enabled cloud labs. Its ADME-One service, which Ginkgo says is cheaper than WuXi by 10X with work done in Boston, has signed on 17 customers in its first 6 weeks; in Q3 Ginkgo is increasing the total number of devices housed in Nebula's RACs, where more than 100 robots run experiments around the clock. The Q2 revenue decrease (to $20 million from $39 million) is primarily attributed to ongoing program rationalization as part of restructuring.
quarterly_data.figure: $47 million, 97-instrument PNNL EMSL autonomous lab; 17 ADME-One customers in first 6 weeks; more than 100 robots
